source: Procedural boxes authored for this local project; no external mesh, texture or sprite bundled
inspiration: The Binding of Isaac Angel Room statue: the stationary room prop, not the Isaac boss or an ordinary praying angel
status: Original voxel fan interpretation after visual inspection of an in-game screenshot; not an official asset; local preview
original_horse: Preserved at its original imported coordinates near (-62.6, +19.2)
construction: 0.2 metre stepped voxel sculpture with solid rounded head, original simplified wing contours, and runs merged along all three axes; 292 boxes and 3504 triangles in one opaque batch
asset_search_result: Existing projects and model listings were checked; no verified ready-to-use complete 3D Angel Room statue was found in the inspected results. Partial character models, sprite mods and a combined flat Joy-Con holder were not imported.
attribution_note: The Binding of Isaac is associated with Edmund McMillen and Nicalis; no ownership of the underlying character design is claimed
